# Zen Mesh — Documentation Index

> Zen Mesh is webhook delivery infrastructure for public and private networks. It delivers webhooks from providers such as Stripe, GitHub, Shopify, and Twilio to any public HTTP endpoint (zero-install, no runtime required) or to private services behind NAT/firewall using outbound-only Edge Lite (Docker) or Kubernetes Edge delivery. No inbound ports, no VPN, no kernel modules.

Zen Mesh publishes public product, pricing, support, documentation, and evidence-scope information. Private roadmap, future architecture, and patent-sensitive implementation details are intentionally not included.

**Version:** 1.3.0 · **Last-Updated:** 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z

## Canonical discovery (crawlers)

- **Canonical documentation:** `https://www.zen-mesh.io/docs/` — all documentation pages live under this origin.
- **Machine-readable JSON (canonical):** served under the `/docs/ai/` path prefix — discovery, evidence, and security registries (`application/json`, no client-side routing); start at [AI overview](https://www.zen-mesh.io/docs/zen-mesh/ai/overview).
- **AI context index (site):** `https://www.zen-mesh.io/llms.txt`
- **Legacy hostname:** `https://www.zen-mesh.io/docs` now permanently redirects to `https://www.zen-mesh.io/docs/`. Use canonical www/docs URLs everywhere.
